note: Official NFL.com news items that materially affect Week 9 game context. Both are season-ending injuries reported on nfl.com.

items.headline: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin out for rest of season with torn patellar tendon
items.summary: Per head coach Dan Quinn, tests showed a torn patellar tendon suffered in the Monday loss to the 49ers; McLaurin will undergo surgery and miss the remainder of the 2026 season.
items.affects: WAS — Week 9 game LA at WAS (2026-11-08)

items.headline: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts likely out for rest of 2026 season due to blood clots (placed on IR)
items.summary: Eagles placed Hurts on injured reserve after doctors found a deep vein thrombosis and bilateral pulmonary emboli; he is expected to miss the remainder of the 2026 season. Tanner McKee is the backup per his official NFL.com player page (NGS Week 8: PHI).
items.affects: PHI — Week 9 game NYG at PHI (2026-11-08)
